Class PointOfRoute

java.lang.Object
domain.PointOfRoute
public class PointOfRoute extends Object
Represents a point in a route with a station and specific cargo types to pick up

    • PointOfRoute

      public PointOfRoute(Station station, List<Carriage.Type> cargoTypes, CargoMode cargoMode)
      Constructs a PointOfRoute object with a specified station, list of cargo types, and cargo mode.
      Parameters:
      station - the station associated with this point in the route
      cargoTypes - the list of cargo types to be handled at this point in the route
      cargoMode - the mode of cargo operation at this point in the route
